verdict.rationale: Raygun offers an AI-powered chat for collaboratively diagnosing and resolving errors (root-cause suggestions, chat interface) and has an official MCP server enabling AI agents to interact with Raygun data, which supports some natural-language operation via connected agents. However, there is no evidence of natural-language commands for broader product operation (e.g., searching, filtering, configuring, or managing errors) beyond the AI resolution chat. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven control over core dashboard actions (filtering, tagging, exporting, settings), first-party documentation of the MCP server's capabilities, and independent confirmation of its reliability.
